rules: Every state_adds item persists in all later continuity_carry_in arrays.
Sola's left forearm fracture begins CH04-S03 and is never healed in this volume.
Sola's long coat left sleeve is cut in CH04-S04; a short field coat and ivory brace begin CH06-S01.
Sola's Hold burns out in CH06-S04 and never returns.
Sola's pathwright office and intact copper bracer end in CH08-S03.
The Chorus mantle begins only after CH09-S04.
Tarin's badge cracks CH02-S03, is surrendered CH03-S01, and is broken CH07-S02.
Tarin's spear bends CH05-S02, shatters CH07-S03, and its fragments become the chorus fork CH09-S02.
Outer Lantern remains unresolved after CH06-S04 until its signal in CH09-S03.
Serac's core vow is sincere and is preserved when borrowed terms are severed.
AnimationShotPlan and E-Conte remain null everywhere.
